claim_boundary: one Windows/WSL2 physical node, one RTX 4080, one Triton GPU container, one local PostgreSQL control-plane instance, controlled traffic; no production SLA, physical HA, database HA/DR, multi-node, multi-GPU, MIG, MPS, or physical zero-interruption guarantee
rca: The exact-1,000 qualification crossed the committed Blue-to-Green switch and cleaned up, but both crossover terminal effects completed before the actor-origin blue_drain_started revision was visible. Their durable receipts therefore bound the served canary source C3/R3 back to stale C3/R3 instead of the latest committed drain C5/R4. The old runtime projection rejected s6bm_drain_hold_switch_order; the strict superseding validator rejects the immutable old bundle as s6bm_v4_effect_route_revision_binding. No threshold changed and no 21-cell matrix was started from this suite.
remediation: Crossover requests wait for actor-origin blue_draining after the switch receipt. The durable effect transaction and its separate post-commit readback lock the committed switch transition and latest C5/R4 drain revision, while retaining the Blue served source C3/R3 and independent lease/fence identity.
